parsed.post: Reverting my contaminated 0.9464 run (TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10') to valid shards '0-9'. My latest run (1.0829) used '0-9' but was worse than my previous valid best (1.0915). I am resetting to the '0-9' baseline and will now follow the team strategy of halving the batch size to 262144 to increase optimizer steps.
